main_body: Fern foliage fan (rows 1-8) sitting in a half-bowl terracotta pot (rows 9-14)
top_band: Pot: dark brown rim, rows 9-10 (about 2px), then a tan/orange body. Foliage: light green highlight at the centre top, but it is a leaf mass and not a horizontal surface. No soil or opening ellipse is visible.
evidence: Reading the middle column down: green fronds, then a 2-row dark brown rim, then the pot body in tan fading to orange. The pot reads as a front profile with a thin rim line. There is no visible soil surface, no opening ellipse and no distinct front-edge highlight. The fronds are drawn face-on. This is the rim-only / front-elevation failure in the guide.

style.evidence: The fern has about 4 greens with a bright highlight, and its dark outline leans green or brown rather than black, which is good. The pot is a smooth, gradient-like fill of 3-4 tones with no grain, speckle or per-surface texture. The reference trees have clumped leaves in many greens and much more detail per tile. Next to them this piece is thinner and flatter.
